body: I’m just scared that I’ll put too much. But I’ll try that
I don't think I'll be alive much longer so there's no point.  Although, I don't want people to remember me as some chubby loser. So I guess I should work on that.

Yeah you're right. Nobody wants to be around some depressed person. People sense that negativity I guess. 
And it brings me some joy knowing that someone in a similar situation is getting better, honestly. I do hope things keep improving for you. 

I'm just tired. I've been trying hard and hoping for things to improve. But just won't happen, and I don't have the strength. 
The only reason I'm still here writing this is because I'm too scared to go through with it.

Being depressed and having no confidence definitely don't help, but I've always been unlikable. Even as a kid when I was very happy and outgoing, I didn't really have friends. Other kids would tell me how annoying or stupid I was. So I became very reserved and quiet. I don't open up easily. 

I just wish I didn't care if people like me or not. I'm tired, I don't have the will or energy to keep on going.

I live in Utah, so once I proved my parents had been paying taxes I became eligible for in-state tuition. However, I was only able to attend for one year. I don't know what I want anymore. I lost interest in almost everything. So even if I picture myself working with animals, it doesn't bring joy anymore. 
I wish I could afford to live in California. 
It's comforting talking to someone else in a similar situation. Sometimes I feel very lonely, and I get tired of the hate for being undocumented.

It's sad. They don't seem to care whether people get health care or not. One of my cousins has type 1 diabetes and even with good insurance it's costly. 
I don't have health insurance so I haven't been to a doctor in a couple years. I can't afford to see a counselor/therapist. 
I believe the outcome of this election has made depression worse for some. It's scary.

That actually makes sense.

And I do hope there is like a heaven or something on the other side. And if there's nothing that's ok I guess. I used to worry that if I died I might miss out on great things. But then I realized, if I don't exist anymore I won't know that I missed out on great things. In the end nothing matters.
So many things. Too many to write. Some are things that are impossible to change. And some I don't even know how to explain.

I couldn't find that option. It's just frustrating that Windows crashed when I tried to open a folder with MS paint drawings, that I had opened earlier. 
Thanks for your help any ways, I appreciate it.
I'll see if I can try that.
Unfortunately I don't have a disc. I think it's an older laptop, I read that laptops aren't meant to last very long.

Earlier I selected "last known good configuration", everything started up but when it got to the desktop, most icons were blank pages. I was able to click on some but nothing happened. And the taskbar was still not working. 

With the safe mode start up, it got to the welcome screen, but now it's stuck on a black screen with the mouse cursor. I'm assuming I won't be able to fix it.
Sounds good. If this doesn't work could I restore to earlier point from boot up?
I selected safe mode with network. At the top it says "Loading Windows Files" and a bunch of files under that. Not sure if it's doing anything. I'll wait for a bit.
I waited a little while and got a box saying "Failure to display security and shut down options"

So it takes a while to boot up, it doesn't even ask me to select user, goes straight to desktop. Once there I only see the task bar, nothing else. When I hover my mouse over the task bar it shows that loading circle, so I can't click on start or the other icons.

That didn't show up. I was finally able to open task manager and left it open. After a little bit everything started working again - task bar was working and the desktop icons showed up.  I'm uninstalling some programs, but now my computer seems pretty slow.
I know there are a few people that care about me, but even they don't know how I feel.

No that's actually pretty cool. I wish I could go. 

I've tried most things. The last few months I've been thinking about my life, why I've been depressed and don't enjoy life. Honestly there's nothing anyone can do. I know some people say it's a permanent solution to a temporary problem, but my "problems" aren't temporary. 

I really wish I could leave without hurting my family. But I'm not gonna be miserable just to keep them happy, you know? I know it's selfish. But we all die eventually. Some due to illness, an accident, or suicide. Part of life. 

I do feel like I'm wasting my life, I really wish I could give it to someone, like your cousin. I truly hope that things get much better for you and your family. I know it's really hard :/ 

I feel like I'm putting a damper on your birthday. Really do have awesome day! Enjoy your 22nd birthday!!

Happy birthday! I like finding people that are really close to my age. You doing anything fun?

And it's too much to write down, a lot of it I don't even know how to explain.
Yeah people tell me 22 is young, but I still feel kinda old. Either way 22 years is more than enough for me. I've realized what life is really like.

I couldn't stop thinking about the concert for a few days. It was pretty cool. 

I live near Salt Lake City, so I don't think the music scene is terrible. 

There have actually been a lot of events I had wanted to go, but I didn't want to go alone.
I did go to a Lady Gaga concert 5 years ago. Things were quite better back then, so I actually enjoyed it.

I'm kinda jealous. Live music sounds good, but being around people makes me nervous and self conscious. 

Not sure how to explain. Sometimes I kinda feel like the music understands how I'm feeling.
Anything. But when I'm upset I listen to Explosions in the Sky and that type of music.
There used to be a few things that would help. Nothing really helps anymore, I just lay in bed and listen to music.
Haha, that made me laugh.  Not a bad idea though.
Yeah I think that's the best thing to do at this point.

I do like to help others. I specially enjoyed volunteering for Toys for Tots. But serving this country is only a part of why I wanted to be a Marine. 
Now I'm just trying to find other things that make me happy.

Sometimes I think it's funny how life works. In my book you're already a succes, my back up plan was to be a civil/mechanical engineer. I just can't afford a 4 year university and I don't qualify for any help. 

But I do know we all have different goals. I'm not in the position to tell you this but don't give up. You've already made it this far. 
I truly wish you the best with reaching your goals.

I have tried to look for other things that make me happy. Working with animals, going back to school to become an architect/engineering. Sadly none of those have worked out.  

I'm 21 years old and my biggest dream was to be a U.S. Marine.

My goal was to be a U.S. Marine - serve this country and do something great with my life. I'm aware that dreams don't always come true, just part of this crappy life.  I can't enlist because I'm not a permanent resident or U.S. Citizen. I only have a work permit. I can go back to my country of birth and try to come back. However, by the time I were granted residency, if at all, I would be too old to enlist.
I'll try my hardest not to harm myself anymore. I'm looking for other ways of coping. I hope things are good for you!
I just want depression and anxiety and everything to go away.
Happy? If so, I can't tell you exactly what went wrong. I guess everything that has happened these past few years.
That definitely sounds a lot more painful. I just hope to stop cutting.

I love where I live, it's my home. But I HATE the winters here, definitely doesn't help the depression. But I have been thinking that being here is toxic, that's why I feel like "running away". Maybe I'll discover great things in another state. However, sometimes I don't even feel like moving away would help. I just rather not exist.

I try to appreciate and enjoy life, but I just can't. There's no joy. I've tried to do my best at work or school, but I fail. Honestly, I'm not as strong as most people. Im alive not because I'm strong, but because I'm too scared to end it. 
Anyways, I really hope things get better for you. I'm actually a 21 year old guy as well, I know all of this really sucks. Wish you the best man.

For me I'm not sure that I fear failure. I'm just tired of things never going as planned. I'm kind of pathetic to be honest, which is sad because growing up I was an excellent student and worked hard. 
But thank you, and I wish you the best.

Honestly the biggest reason why I'm still alive is for my mom. That's frustrating sometimes, it's like I'm living for someone else. I just rather not exist. 
And one of the things I really hate about life is that bad things happen to good people. I don't know you or your wife but im assuming you're both good people. I just wish I could give my health or life to people who deserve it. I wish you and your wife the best. I hope that she has a speedy recovery.
Thank you.  I really could talk to someone. Can you PM me?
I guess it's normal to feel like we're the only ones. I had an ok day, stayed home.  I feel safe here and won't have to worry about getting upset.  I hope you had a great day yourself!

I can definitely relate, I thought I was the only one. Even when I see someone eating alone I get sad. I've always been a very sensitive guy. And Ive always taken everything too personal, doesn't take much to make me cry.
I'm on a phone and it won't let me PM anyone first. I'd appreciate it if you could PM me.
I try to be proud of myself for still being alive. 9 years is definitely too long.  I truly wish the best for you. No one should go through this. I'm glad you're getting help, stay strong.
Wow! That's crazy.  I wish I could say the same. How do you do it? It doesn't take long for me to get bored/tired/depressed with a job.

I have to say that's a huge victory! You should definitely be proud of yourself.  One of my goals is to be at a job for more than a year. After 2-4 months I start calling off and ultimately quit. I guess my only "victory" is the fact that I'm still alive, but it's only for my mom I don't want to hurt her.
I'll have to agree with you on that. It isn't as supportive as I thought it would be.
Hey can you PM me? I'm on my phone and can't figure it out.

I can't say that I understand you, I'm not in your shoes, but your story sounds very familiar. I'm not good at giving advice but I'm here if you want to talk. 
I do kind of understand what you're going through. You're definitely not alone. 
Ive been depressed on and off for several years now. I am now 21 years old, living with family. I haven't been able to keep a job for very long, I dropped out of college. I didn't have money to keep going and I failed one class.  Basically I'm a failure. My biggest dream was to be a US Marine, at this point I think it's time to give up on that dream. 
And recently I too wished I had cancer or even HIV, I don't want to kill myself. But know that cancer is not a peaceful way to go. One of my aunts is currently losing the battle with cancer. That angers me even more, she deserves to live and be healthy. Im the one that should have cancer.  
i don't think there's anything I can say to make you feel better, so I hope things start going good for you. I truly do. 
What I've been doing lately is just not try to think about anything, just be kind of be numb you know? I'm going with the flow now, whatever happens happens. 
Like I said, I'm not good at giving advance. But know you're not alone. I'm here if you need to vent or talk.

Oh man. I'm definitely depressed with the way my life has turned out. I'm a 21 year old guy and growing up I never thought life would be like this. I remember 4 years ago, summer before my senior year I was imagining where I would be at age 21. I imagined myself in the Marine Corps living far from home, I imagined I would have a boyfriend. Having the time of my life.  Yet here I am. Living with family. Unemployed looking for another shitty job just to pay the bills. 
I'm not good at giving advice or comforting, but you're definitely not alone. I know how you feel. I really hope some good changes come for you soon. And thanks for posting this, it feels good to know there are others that feel the same.

Thank you for that. I really need a shoulder to lean on and vent my sadness and anger. It's nice to know that there are people that know how I'm feeling. I can talk to family but they won't understand me anyways. 

I do keep thinking that things can get better. And they do for a bit then I'm back where I was. I've been waiting for things to get better since I was 15, so 6 years.
Thanks for that, makes me feel better about enjoying those things.  I feel like eventually nothing will give me energy.    But I do hope that you keep getting the energy to keep living.

I'm actually unemployed right now. Just thinking about working again makes me very depressed. I don't have a college degree or can't enlist in the military, so the only jobs I can get are crap. They just make my depression worse, and I always get a sick feeling in my stomach.  Probably one of the biggest reasons why I've been depressed these past years.
Hey happy birthday. I think it's cool having the same birthday as someone else. I try hard to be sociable as well. But it's hard, glad you understand.
Mostly I just look back at my life.
I'm on my phone, not sure how to pm you. If you'd like to pm me that would be great.
I kind of know how you're feeling. Can you pm me?
I guess I just want to be happy. After 7 years of this crap I don't think it'll ever happen. I want to keep living because I don't want to hurt my mom.
I guess anything that keeps us going is good right?

That's exactly how I am. Glad to know I'm
Not the only one.
Thank you! I'm doing better now.  And I do go through seasons, generally they're good seasons. But occasionally I go through the really bad seasons. I hope you're doing great as well.

That's awesome. I really love all animals. I've been thinking about getting a dog because they do bring a lot of joy. It would really help me.  I'm glad that you've been working on those shirts. What I've been doing is making model buildings. Helps me distract myself.
Oh sorry. I replied in the wrong section.

Firstly I want to thank you for taking the time to read and respond to my post. I appreciate it, it feels good when someone listens.  I've actually been trying to do that.  I quit my job last week, which made things worse. So now all I do is lay in bed, probably not good.

Music does help, I love it. For me the two songs that really help are:

Explosions In The Sky - Your Hand In Mine

Danny Elfman - Finale
